title: Shila, grandson of Rav Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Yalkut, Ezekiel, section 366, he objects: “Is not rolling painful for the righteous?” The statement appears in Ketubot 111a under Rabbi Abba Sala Rabba.

notes.text: The source’s גלגל is read in context as rolling; its spelling remains unchanged. The Yalkut and Ketubot attribute the question to different names.
The consulted Yalkut has Rav Shila, grandson of Rav Acha, and spells “rolling” גלגול. Ketubot 111a names Rabbi Abba Salla Rabba in the parallel objection.
